correctness.rationale: For every commutative coefficient algebra R, square-zero generator images force c²=e²=0, and invertibility is equivalent to Δ=ag+bf being a unit by nilpotent reduction. The resulting group scheme has reduced dimension six and tangent dimension eight. On V=A/k, field-valued images are block parabolic with Δ lower diagonal and exhaust the projective parabolic by scalar renormalization. The derivation action gives every traceless 3x3 matrix exactly once; char 2 does not divide 3, so the derivative to Lie PGL3 is an isomorphism. These algebraic arguments apply universally, independent of finite checker.

value.rationale: The exceptional Witt–sl3 identification alone suggests eight infinitesimal symmetry directions; ordinary coordinate automorphisms display only a six-dimensional parabolic. The finding quantifies and explains this gap with a length-four nonreduced thickening, explicit two infinitesimal translation directions, and an actual isomorphism of Lie differentials despite proper global image. This is a structural warning about replacing group schemes by geometric point groups, not merely a group order computation.
